# AWeber: Email Marketing & Automation for Small Businesses

> AWeber is an email marketing and automation platform founded in 1998, trusted by small businesses, creators, coaches, bloggers, and entrepreneurs. AWeber provides tools to grow email lists, send newsletters, automate email workflows, build landing pages, and sell products. AWeber offers 24/7 customer support and free account migration from other platforms.

- Primary domain: aweber.com

## About AWeber

- [About AWeber](https://www.aweber.com/about.htm): Company history, mission, and team behind AWeber's email marketing platform.
- [Careers at AWeber](https://www.aweber.com/careers.htm): Job opportunities and company culture at AWeber.
- [AWeber Certified Experts](https://www.aweber.com/certified-experts/): Directory of certified professionals who provide AWeber-related services.
- [AWeber Community](https://community.aweber.com/): Forum and community for AWeber users to connect, learn, and share strategies.
- [AWeber Customer Referral Program](https://www.aweber.com/advocates.htm): Earn rewards by referring other small businesses and creators to AWeber.

## Core Product & Features

- [Email Marketing Features](https://www.aweber.com/email-marketing-features.htm): Complete suite of email marketing tools for small businesses — drag-and-drop email builder, automated email sequences, behavioral tagging and segmentation, AI-assisted content creation, performance analytics, and industry-leading deliverability to ensure emails reach the inbox.
- [Email Automation](https://www.aweber.com/email-automation.htm): Build automated email sequences and campaigns triggered by subscriber behavior. Includes pre-built automation templates so businesses can set up welcome sequences, sales funnels, and follow-up campaigns quickly.
- [Newsletter Assistant](https://www.aweber.com/newsletter-assistant.htm): AI-powered tool that drafts, designs, and sends newsletters for small businesses — reducing the time and skill required to publish a consistent email newsletter.
- [Landing Page Builder](https://www.aweber.com/ai/landing-page-builder.htm): A simple, no-code drag-and-drop landing page builder to capture leads, promote products, and grow an email list. No coding or design experience required.
- [Sign Up Form Builder](https://www.aweber.com/ai/signup-form.htm): Embeddable opt-in forms to collect email subscribers from any website, blog, or social media platform.
- [Ecommerce](https://www.aweber.com/solutions/ecommerce.htm): Sell from AWeber landing pages and emails: take Stripe payments on a landing page, add Shopify products with the Shopify Buy Button, and put buy buttons in emails.
- [Web Push Notifications](https://www.aweber.com/web-push-notifications.htm): Send browser-based push notifications to re-engage website visitors even when they're not in their inbox.
- [AI Writing Assistant](https://www.aweber.com/ai-email-writer.htm): AI tool that generates email subject lines and body copy, helping small business owners write more effective emails in less time.
- [Link in Bio Page](https://www.aweber.com/link-in-bio.htm): Mobile-optimized link-in-bio page for Instagram, TikTok, and other social platforms — consolidates links and drives followers to an email list or offer.

## Pricing

- [AWeber Pricing](https://www.aweber.com/pricing.htm): Plans and pricing for AWeber's email marketing platform, including free trial with credit card plan details.
- [AWeber Done For You](https://www.aweber.com/email-launch.htm): A complete email marketing setup service where AWeber's experts build your email marketing, landing pages, signup forms, automated welcome sequences, and newsletter drafts in just 7 days for $79 plus monthly subscription.

## Solutions by Use Case

- [AWeber for Bloggers](https://www.aweber.com/bloggers.htm): How bloggers use AWeber to grow their audience and monetize content.
- [AWeber for Coaches](https://www.aweber.com/coaching.htm): Email marketing tools and strategies tailored for coaches and consultants.
- [AWeber for Etsy Shops](https://www.aweber.com/etsy.htm): How Etsy sellers use AWeber to drive repeat purchases and build customer relationships.
- [AWeber for Newsletters](https://www.aweber.com/email-newsletters.htm): Tools and features for creating and monetizing email newsletters.
- [AWeber for Nonprofits](https://www.aweber.com/solutions/nonprofits.htm): Email marketing for nonprofits: 3 months of Lite or Plus free, then 25% off every invoice, plus donation pages through Stripe and phone, chat, and email support.
- [AWeber for YouTubers](https://www.aweber.com/youtuber.htm): How YouTube creators use AWeber to grow their email list and automate engagement.

## Competitor Comparisons

- [AWeber vs Mailchimp](https://www.aweber.com/aweber-vs-mailchimp.htm): Feature and pricing comparison between AWeber and Mailchimp.
- [AWeber vs GetResponse](https://www.aweber.com/aweber-vs-getresponse.htm): How AWeber compares to GetResponse for small business email marketing.
- [AWeber vs ConvertKit](https://www.aweber.com/aweber-vs-convertkit.htm): Side-by-side comparison of AWeber and ConvertKit for creators.
- [AWeber vs Constant Contact](https://www.aweber.com/aweber-vs-constant-contact.htm): AWeber vs Constant Contact features, pricing, and support.

## Support & Resources

- [Contact AWeber Support](https://www.aweber.com/contact-us.htm): Contact AWeber by phone, live chat, and email support from in-house customer solutions team. Available 24/7.
- [AWeber Knowledge Base](https://docs.aweber.com): Help articles, tutorials, and documentation for using AWeber.
- [Free Account Migration](https://www.aweber.com/migration.htm): AWeber's free service to migrate your list and campaigns from another email platform.
- [App Integrations](https://www.aweber.com/integrations/): AWeber integrates with 750+ tools including PayPal, Shopify, WordPress, Facebook, and Zapier.
- [Landing Page Templates](https://www.aweber.com/templates/landing-pages/): Pre-built landing page templates available in AWeber.
- [Pre-Written Email Campaigns](https://www.aweber.com/campaign-marketplace.htm): Done-for-you email campaign templates for common business use cases.
- [Virtual Events](https://www.aweber.com/events/): Webinars and live training events hosted by AWeber.

## Legal, Privacy & Compliance

- [Privacy Policy](https://www.aweber.com/privacy.htm): How AWeber collects, uses, and protects customer and subscriber data.
- [Anti-Spam Policy](https://www.aweber.com/antispam.htm): AWeber's strict anti-spam standards and enforcement policies.
- [Data Processing & Security Terms](https://www.aweber.com/dpst.htm): AWeber's data processing agreement and security commitments.

## Blog & Learning

- [AWeber Blog](https://blog.aweber.com): Email marketing tips, strategies, and resources for small businesses and creators.
- [Marketing Glossary](https://blog.aweber.com/marketing-glossary): Definitions of key email marketing and digital marketing terms.

## Optional

- [AWeber Sitemap](https://www.aweber.com/sitemap.xml): Full sitemap of aweber.com pages.
